summary: Lucas GC Limited filed a Form 6-K announcing a 125-for-1 share consolidation of its Class A and Class B ordinary shares, effective September 1, 2026, following shareholder approval at an EGM on December 5, 2025, and a board resolution on May 28, 2026, initially fixing an 80-for-1 ratio but later revised. The consolidation is a routine capital structure adjustment to maintain NASDAQ listing compliance, not a special situation. The filing also includes an amended memorandum and articles of association. No deal terms, premiums, or advisors are involved; this is a mechanical share count reduction with no strategic event.
